searchText: question on the validators post-merge when I create a validator now (pre-merge), I setup a pubkey where the rewards are done and I have multiple of these per node. what about the execution layer, where the fee tips are? will an extra field be added or something? just point me to the right place if it was discussed some discussion here from the beginning of february, not sure if there is something more recent https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/692062809701482577/940128388012716052 <dannyryan> You reuse the Coinbase field in the execution layer <dannyryan> This can be set each block. Validator clients will allow configuration ah, okay, so validator clients will set it up for me, if I provide them <pubkey>-><pubkey> mapping or something? <dannyryan> Yes is there any validator client that I can try out already? we're making progress on it in Prysm, and that feature might be done within the next few days the configuration of fee recipients in the validator client any docs I can take a look at? even if it is in a github branch happy to share if you dm me your email : ) Here’s the LH docs for the fee recipient: https://lighthouse-book.sigmaprime.io/suggested-fee-recipient.html Just to add to the details, Teku lets you configure a default fee recipient and then override it on a per validator basis: https://github.com/ConsenSys/teku/pull/4894 Thanks!

question on the validators post-merge

when I create a validator now (pre-merge), I setup a pubkey where the rewards are done and I have multiple of these per node.

what about the execution layer, where the fee tips are? will an extra field be added or something?
